name: rest-api
description: Starter intent-graph for a small HTTP REST API: target, resource model, request workflow, and one handler unit.

nodes.prompt: A backend service exposing a small REST API over HTTP.
nodes.label: REST API project

nodes.prompt: Serve a JSON HTTP API with CRUD endpoints over a single resource collection. Stateless request handling; errors returned as JSON with appropriate status codes.
nodes.label: HTTP JSON API target

nodes.prompt: The primary resource the API manages: a typed record with a stable id and a small set of fields. Define its shape, identity, and validation rules.
nodes.label: Resource model
rules: REQUIRE: every resource has a stable unique id
FORBID: mutating the id after creation

nodes.prompt: Handle one HTTP request: parse and validate input, dispatch by method (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE), apply the operation to the resource store, and serialise the response.
nodes.label: Request handling workflow

nodes.prompt: Implement the GET /resources handler: return the full collection as a JSON array with a 200 status.
nodes.label: List resources handler
